newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens higher as options expiry looms.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens higher as options expiry looms.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index opened with modest gains on Friday but was pulled back by a weaker opening in the futures market ahead of June index options expiry.
"The options expiry will make the market very jumpy this morning," said one derivatives specialist. "We could actually jump 25 points either way as it gets closer."
The lead index was up 7.6 points at 4,956.6 by 0739 GMT after profit-taking dragged the index back from the brink of the 5,000 level on Thursday.
A weaker performance in New York could also weigh on shares.
